parameters.content:
## Daily n8n instance health check

### How it works

This workflow runs daily at 06:30 or on demand to audit the health of an n8n instance. It loads configuration, fetches published workflows and recent executions, filters the workflows in scope, and checks for missed schedules, errored runs, unprotected failure paths, and risky sub-workflow calls. It then builds a digest and sends an email only when there is something that needs attention; otherwise it ends without notification.

### Setup steps

- Configure the n8n credentials used by the n8n nodes so they can read workflows and executions from the target instance.
- Set the Config node values for alertEmail, scopeTags, instanceUrl, and defaultTimezone.
- Configure the Gmail credentials and sender settings for the Email Health Digest node.
- Verify the daily schedule time and timezone match the desired monitoring window.

### Customization

Adjust scopeTags and the code-node checks to change which workflows are monitored, how far back execution history is reviewed, and what conditions should trigger the digest email.

## Start and configure

Contains the scheduled and manual entry points plus the shared configuration values used throughout the health check.

## Fetch scoped workflows

Retrieves published workflows from the n8n instance and applies tag or scope rules to decide which workflows will be checked.

## Gather execution context

Fetches recent execution errors and selects in-scope workflows that have enabled schedule triggers for deeper validation.

## Check schedule activity

Looks up recent runs for scheduled workflows and detects schedules that appear to have missed their expected firing window.

## Audit workflow risks

Analyzes errored executions, workflow failure handling, and sub-workflow call references to identify silent failures or broken dependencies.

## Build notification digest

Compiles the health findings into a digest and decides whether the results warrant sending an email.

## Send or suppress email

Either emails the health digest to the configured recipient or exits cleanly when all checks are clear.

nodes.name: Get Recent Error Logs
nodes.notes: The executions API has no date filter, only workflow + status. Results come newest first, so 250 reaches well past a day on most instances; the time cut happens in Check Errored Runs.

nodes.name: Retrieve Last Runs
nodes.notes: One request per scheduled workflow, not one instance-wide scan: a busy webhook workflow emits hundreds of executions a day and would push everything else out of any global window. Every execution carries its workflowId, so no loop is needed.

nodes.name: Send Health Digest Email
nodes.notes: No Retry On Fail here on purpose: a retried send that actually went through duplicates the mail.
